measurement_notes: Fixed benchmark source is byte-identical to integration base; each workload retains one warmup and 20 measured steps/ray batches.
Profile comparisons force original brute scans and accelerated scans in the same binary. Complete-step and ray execution order alternate over 20 repetitions. Cold samples are brute-first.
Independent phase probes overlap and must not be summed. Order probes include actual already-ordered equal-time impacts and separately labeled synthetic descending times.
Allocation runs use the pinned Mojo runtime hook with passing selftest and no record overflow. Hooked timing is excluded from native speed claims.
Peak requested bytes include only live allocations created inside each phase. Retained index bytes are node capacity payload and exclude original geometry, octree, allocator metadata and RSS.
restore_copy_replay copies lists and differs from production rollback moves; failed_step_with_rollback includes error-string check/assert.
Estimated amortized rows are algebraic estimates at 1/2/5/20/100/1000 lifetimes, not additional measured steps.
